and.definition: And means a word that joins two things together.

on.definition: On means touching or covering the top part of something.

from.definition: From means starting at a particular place, time, or level.

or.definition: Or means a word you use to show a choice between two or more things.

go.definition: Go means to move or travel to another place.

say.definition: Say means to use words to tell a message.

they.definition: They means a word we use to talk about two or more people, animals, or things.

she.definition: She means a female person or animal that we talk about.

all.definition: All means every one of a group or the whole of something.

we.definition: We means the person who is talking and one or more other people together.

he.definition: He means a word we use to talk about a boy or a man.

know.definition: Know means to have information about something in your mind.

will.definition: Will means a word we use to talk about things that have not happened yet.

more.definition: More means a bigger amount or number of something.

when.definition: When means a word you use to ask about the time or day.

think.definition: Think means to use your brain to have ideas or to make pictures in your mind.

who.definition: Who means a word we use to ask about a person or people.

about.definition: About means having to do with a certain topic or person.

like.definition: Like means to enjoy something or think it is nice.

time.definition: Time means how we measure the passing of moments, like minutes, hours, and days.

come.definition: Come means to move closer to someone or to go where they are.

want.definition: Want means to feel that you would like to have something.

now.definition: Now means at the present time or moment.

contextual_layout.normal_text: you eat a pill that gives your body extra good things it needs.

adjustment.definition: Adjustment means a small change you make to something so it works better.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I make an adjustment to my chair.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you change your chair a little so it feels better.

abstract.definition: Abstract means something you can think about but cannot touch or see, like an idea or a feeling.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: This painting is abstract.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the painting does not show real things like people or trees, but uses shapes and colors to show an idea.

reasonably.definition: Reasonably means in a fair and sensible way, not too much or too little.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: He reasonably shared his toys with his friend.
contextual_layout.normal_text: he gave his toys to his friend in a fair and kind way.

precise.definition: Precise means very accurate and exact, with no mistakes.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The clock is precise.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the clock shows the exact time without any error.

sheep.definition: Sheep means a farm animal with thick, soft wool that people keep for its wool and meat.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The sheep is eating grass in the field.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you see a fluffy animal that eats green plants outside.

distant.definition: Distant means far away in space or time.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The mountain looks distant.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the mountain is very far from where you stand.

shade.definition: Shade means a dark place where something blocks the light.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I sit in the shade of a tree.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you are sitting where the tree blocks the sun, so it is cool and dark.

leather.definition: Leather means a strong material made from the skin of an animal, used to make things like shoes and bags.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: This bag is made of leather.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the bag is made from the skin of an animal.

leap.definition: Leap means to jump forward with big steps.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The frog can leap over the log.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you see a frog jump high and far to get over a piece of wood.

uncertainty.definition: Uncertainty means a feeling when you do not know what will happen next.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I feel uncertainty about the test.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you are not sure what will happen on the test.

probability.definition: Probability means what the chances are that something will happen.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: There is a high probability of rain today.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you think it is very likely that rain will fall from the sky today.

tent.definition: Tent means a small house made of cloth that you can put up outside to sleep in.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: We sleep in a tent at night.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you rest inside a cloth shelter when it is dark.

stranger.definition: Stranger means a person you do not know.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I see a stranger at the door.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you see a person you do not know standing at the door.

summarize.definition: Summarize means to tell the main ideas of something in a short way.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I can summarize the story.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you tell the most important parts of the story in just a few words.

grain.definition: Grain means the small, hard seeds of plants like wheat, rice, or corn that people use for food.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The farmer stores grain in a big barn.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the farmer keeps the small seeds from plants in a large building.

shore.definition: Shore means the land along the edge of a sea, lake, or river.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I walk on the shore.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you are walking on the land next to the water.

situate.definition: Situate means to put something in a certain place.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I situate my toy on the shelf.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you put your toy on the shelf so it stays there.

monthly.definition: Monthly means happening once every month.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I read a monthly book club magazine.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you look at a magazine that comes to your house one time each month.

snap.definition: Snap means to break something long and thin with a sudden, sharp sound.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I snap the twig.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you break a small branch with a quick, loud noise.

stir.definition: Stir means to mix something by moving it around in a circle with a spoon or stick.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I stir my soup with a spoon.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you use a spoon to move the soup around in circles.

experimental.definition: Experimental means trying something new to see what happens.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: This is an experimental cake recipe.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you are baking a cake in a way that has not been tried before, just to see if it tastes good.

wander.definition: Wander means to walk around without a plan or a goal.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I wander in the park.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you walk around the park without knowing where you are going.

attendance.definition: Attendance means being at a place or event when you are supposed to be there.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I have good attendance at school.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you go to school every day and do not miss any days.

excitement.definition: Excitement means when people feel very happy and full of energy.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I feel excitement when I see a rainbow.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you feel very happy and your heart beats fast because the rainbow looks so pretty.

sigh.definition: Sigh means to breathe out slowly and loudly to show you are tired, sad, or bored.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: She sighs when she has to do homework.
contextual_layout.normal_text: she lets out a long breath because she does not want to do it.

gentle.definition: Gentle means being kind and soft, not rough or loud.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The mother gives her baby a gentle hug.
contextual_layout.normal_text: she holds her baby in a soft and loving way, without squeezing too hard.

empire.definition: Empire means a large group of countries that one ruler or government controls.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The king rules an empire.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the king controls many different countries.

pregnancy.definition: Pregnancy means the time when a woman has a baby growing inside her.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: She is happy about her pregnancy.
contextual_layout.normal_text: she feels joy because she will have a baby.

institutional.definition: Institutional means something that belongs to a big organization like a school or a hospital.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The institutional building is very big.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you are talking about a building that belongs to a large organization like a school or a hospital.

swear.definition: Swear means to make a serious promise to do something.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I swear I will tell the truth.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you are making a strong promise to be honest.

suspend.definition: Suspend means to stop something for a little while.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The teacher will suspend the game.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the teacher will stop the game for a short time.

qualification.definition: Qualification means a paper or certificate that shows you have learned something or can do a job.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I got my swimming qualification.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you passed a test and now have a paper that says you can swim well.

stain.definition: Stain means a mark on something that is hard to clean, or to make such a mark.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The red juice made a stain on my shirt.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the red liquid left a dirty spot on your shirt that is not easy to wash off.

comprise.definition: Comprise means to have something as parts or members.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The class comprises twenty students.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the group of students has twenty people in it.

subsequently.definition: Subsequently means after something else happens.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I finish my homework, and subsequently I watch TV.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you do the second thing after you finish the first thing.

voluntary.definition: Voluntary means something you do because you want to, not because someone tells you to.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: She did voluntary work at the animal shelter.
contextual_layout.normal_text: she helped take care of animals because she wanted to, not because she had to.

refugee.definition: Refugee means a person who leaves their home country because of war or danger.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The refugee looks for a safe place to live.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you are talking about someone who had to leave their own country to stay safe from war.

organic.definition: Organic means food that is made or grown with few or no chemicals.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I eat organic apples.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you eat apples that are grown without many chemicals.

athlete.definition: Athlete means a person who trains hard to run, jump, or play sports.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The athlete runs very fast.
contextual_layout.normal_text: a person who practices running and can move quickly in a race.

pale.definition: Pale means light in color, like when something has very little color.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: Her face is pale.
contextual_layout.normal_text: her skin is very light, maybe because she is sick or scared.

ownership.definition: Ownership means that something belongs to you and you have the right to keep it.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I have ownership of this toy.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you are the person who owns that toy.

functional.definition: Functional means something that is useful and works the way it should.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: This tool is functional.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the tool works well and can help you do a job.

tongue.definition: Tongue means the soft, pink part inside your mouth that helps you taste food and talk.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I can taste the ice cream with my tongue.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you can feel the sweet flavor of the cold treat using that part of your mouth.

alongside.definition: Alongside means next to or beside something.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The dog walked alongside its owner.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the dog walked next to its owner.

slice.definition: Slice means a flat piece of food that has been cut from a bigger piece.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I want a slice of cake.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you want a flat piece of cake that was cut from a larger cake.

website.definition: Website means a place on the internet where you can find information about a person, a group, or a thing.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I look at the school website to see my homework.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you use a special page on the internet to find out what you need to do for school.

wipe.definition: Wipe means to clean or dry something by rubbing it with a cloth or your hand.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I wipe the table with a cloth.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you are cleaning the table by rubbing it with a cloth.

gaze.definition: Gaze means to look at something for a long time without moving your eyes.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I gaze at the stars.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you look at the stars in the sky for a long time without blinking.

structural.definition: Structural means about the way something is built or the parts that hold it up.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The bridge needs structural beams.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the bridge needs strong pieces that hold it up so it does not fall.

weird.definition: Weird means something that is strange or not normal.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: That is a weird hat.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the hat looks very strange and not like other hats.

unite.definition: Unite means to join together to make one group or team.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: We unite to clean the park.
contextual_layout.normal_text: all the people come together as one group to make the park clean.

theoretical.definition: Theoretical means something that is thought about but not yet tested or proven in real life.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: We have a theoretical idea about how dinosaurs lived.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you are talking about an idea that people think is true but have not seen or proved yet.

innocent.definition: Innocent means not having done anything wrong or bad.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The kitten is innocent.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the kitten is not guilty of any bad action.

gently.definition: Gently means in a soft, careful, and kind way.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: She gently touched the cat.
contextual_layout.normal_text: she touched the cat in a soft and careful way.

fool.definition: Fool means a person who does something silly or not smart.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The boy acts like a fool when he jumps into the mud.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the boy does a silly thing that is not very smart.

cough.definition: Cough means to push air out of your mouth with a sudden, loud sound, often when you are sick or something bothers your throat.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I cough when I eat too fast.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you make a loud noise from your throat because the food goes down the wrong way.

curtain.definition: Curtain means a piece of cloth that hangs in front of a window.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I open the curtain in the morning.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you move the cloth away from the window to let light come in.

tournament.definition: Tournament means a big contest where many people or teams play games to see who is the best.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: Our team won the tournament.
contextual_layout.normal_text: your team played many games against other teams and came in first place.

hypothesis.definition: Hypothesis means an idea that you think might be true, and you want to test it or learn more about it.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I have a hypothesis about why the sky is blue.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you have an idea that you want to check or study more to see if it is right.

compute.definition: Compute means to find an answer by using math, like adding or counting.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I can compute how many toys I have.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you can add up all your toys to know the total number.

fade.definition: Fade means to slowly become less bright or clear.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The colors on my shirt fade after many washes.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the colors become less bright because you wash the shirt many times.

royal.definition: Royal means something that belongs to a king or queen.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The royal family lives in a big castle.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you are talking about the king, queen, and their children who live in a large, old building.

registration.definition: Registration means the act of writing your name on a list to join something, like a school or a club.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I go to school for registration.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you go to a place to write your name on a paper so you can start learning there.

aunt.definition: Aunt means the sister of your mother or father, or the woman who is married to your uncle.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: My aunt gives me a gift.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the woman who is your mother's or father's sister gives you a present.

fragment.definition: Fragment means a small piece that has broken off from something larger.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I found a fragment of a broken cup.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you found a small piece that broke off from a cup.

density.definition: Density means how many people or things are in a certain space.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The density of trees in the forest is high.
contextual_layout.normal_text: there are many trees close together in that forest.

listener.definition: Listener means a person who pays attention to what someone says.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I am a good listener.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you are a person who carefully hears what other people say.

darkness.definition: Darkness means when there is no light or very little light.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The room is full of darkness.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the room has no light and you cannot see anything.

server.definition: Server means a person who brings food and drinks to people at a restaurant.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The server brings us our food.
contextual_layout.normal_text: a person who works in a restaurant and carries meals to the tables where people sit.

module.definition: Module means a part of a bigger thing that has its own job.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: This module helps the robot move.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you are talking about a part of the robot that does the moving job.

immigration.definition: Immigration means moving from one country to live in another country for a long time.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: My family came here through immigration.
contextual_layout.normal_text: your family moved from another country to live in this one.

ugly.definition: Ugly means not nice to look at; something that does not look pretty.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: That is an ugly dog.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you think the dog does not look nice or pretty.

mayor.definition: Mayor means the person who leads a city or town and helps make rules for it.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The mayor gave a speech in the park.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the leader of the city talked to people in a big outdoor place.

autumn.definition: Autumn means the time of year when the weather gets colder and leaves fall from trees, between summer and winter.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I love the colors of autumn.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you enjoy seeing the leaves turn red, orange, and yellow before they fall off the trees.

solar.definition: Solar means something that relates to the sun, like sunlight or heat from the sun.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The solar panels on the roof make electricity from sunlight.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the flat boards on top of the house use light from the sun to create power for lights and machines.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: She gave her mom a tender hug.
contextual_layout.normal_text: she hugged her mom in a loving and gentle way.

rose.definition: Rose means a red flower that people give to show love.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I picked a rose for my mom.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you took a red flower from a plant to give to your mother.

cheek.definition: Cheek means the soft skin on each side of your face, below your eyes.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I have a red cheek.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the soft skin on one side of your face is the color red.

lazy.definition: Lazy means not wanting to work or move much.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I feel lazy today.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you do not want to do any work or be active.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I am fortunate to have a friend.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you are lucky to have a friend.

insure.definition: Insure means to pay money to a company so that they will give you money if something bad happens to your things.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I insure my bike.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you pay a company some money so they will help you if your bike gets lost or broken.

grin.definition: Grin means to smile a big smile.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I grin when I see my friend.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you show your teeth because you are happy.

hunger.definition: Hunger means the feeling when your body needs food.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I have hunger after playing.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you feel like you need to eat something because you played a lot.

holder.definition: Holder means a person who has or keeps something.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: The holder of the cup is my dad.
contextual_layout.normal_text: your dad is the person who has the cup.

alright.definition: Alright means good enough or okay.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: Your answer is alright.
contextual_layout.normal_text: the answer is not perfect but it is fine and you accept it.

hello.definition: Hello means what you say when you meet someone.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I say hello to my friend.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you greet someone you know.

attachment.definition: Attachment means a strong feeling of love or liking for someone or something.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I have an attachment to my teddy bear.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you feel very close to your teddy bear and do not want to lose it.

faithfully.definition: Faithfully means doing something in a way that shows you are loyal and true.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I faithfully feed my dog every day.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you give food to your dog each day without missing a day.

thirst.definition: Thirst means the feeling that you need to drink something.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I have a thirst after running.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you feel like you need water because you played hard.

noun.definition: Noun means a word that names a person, place, thing, or idea.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I know that 'dog' is a noun.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you understand that the word 'dog' is a name for an animal.

found.definition: Found means to start or create something new, like a company or a club.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: They found a new school in the town.
contextual_layout.normal_text: they build and open a place where children can learn.

ashamed.definition: Ashamed means feeling bad because you did something wrong.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I am ashamed.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you feel bad because you did something wrong.

blog.definition: Blog means a website where a person writes short articles about things they like or think about.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I write a blog about my pet cat.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you have a website where you share stories and pictures of your cat.

plastic.definition: Plastic means a light, strong material that people use to make many different things like toys, cups, and bags.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: I drink water from a plastic bottle.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you use a bottle made of a light, strong material that is not glass or metal.

habit.definition: Habit means something you do again and again, often without thinking.

contextual_layout.highlight_green: Brushing your teeth every morning is a good habit.
contextual_layout.normal_text: you clean your teeth each day, and doing it often keeps them healthy.
